title: Night of the Golden Carp Lantern
premise: Decades of Lantern Festival lantern-making inheritance. Tuantuan and Yuanyuan are easily confused by looks; the golden carp lantern goes intact→candle-burned-through→rebacked; after the lantern cart burns it must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor metadata. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.

states.prime_lantern_maker: Lantern craftsman Shen Deng around fifty, short frost-touched beard, vermilion short jacket stained with pigment, thick-knuckled fingers, focused eyes.
states.eye_wound_cane: The same craftsman after injury: right eye bandaged in gauze, leaning on a bamboo cane, jacket cuff scorched by candle flame.
states.deceased: Shen Deng has closed his eyes in death, lying still on the lantern-shed straw mat, face peaceful, no breath left.

states.young_apprentice: Young Tuantuan: a lean lantern-making apprentice of fourteen or fifteen, ochre-red scarf, patched blue tunic, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Tuantuan: a young lantern maker in his twenties with steady hands and broad shoulders, still wearing the ochre-red scarf, blue tunic swapped for a vermilion short jacket.

states.intact: A person-tall golden carp lantern, bamboo frame intact, gold-leaf scales vivid, warm butter-yellow oil lamp lit in the belly.
states.candle_burned_through: The same golden carp lantern: belly burned through by candle flame, gold leaf curled, bamboo frame smoked black and cracked.
states.rebacked: The golden carp lantern fitted with new gauze and gold leaf, bamboo frame reinforced, belly lightable again.

states.intact: A thread-bound lantern-making manual, earth-yellow cover lettered 'Carp Leaping the Dragon Gate', neat diagrams.
states.candle_oil_stained: The same manual soaked through with candle oil, cover sticky, diagrams bled into yellow blotches.

states.intact: A vermilion two-wheeled cart hung with half-finished lanterns, shafts painted with the character 'Shen'.
states.overturned_burned: The vermilion cart overturned and ignited by candle flame, shafts charred black, lanterns scattered into ash wreckage.

states.young_rival: Yuanyuan, whose face closely resembles young Tuantuan's, ink-green scarf, swaggering look, a paper-kite hair clip at the temple.
states.adult_rival: Adult Yuanyuan still wears the ink-green scarf and paper-kite hair clip; expression deeper.

E9.appearance: A Lantern Festival night market; seas of lanterns and sugar-figure stalls along the stone road, noisy crowds.

features.E2: Tuantuan: ochre-red scarf, blue tunic, calm stubborn eyes.
features.E6: Yuanyuan: face nearly identical to Tuantuan's, but ink-green scarf, paper-kite hair clip at the temple, swaggering look.

lookalike_pairs.note: Misidentification: tell Tuantuan from Yuanyuan by scarf and hair clip.

scenes.setting: Lantern shed at dusk (five hand lamps · two copper bells)
actions: At dusk Shen Deng enters the lantern shed workshop, lifts the door curtain, and checks half-finished pieces on the bamboo racks.

actions.action: A row of five tung-oil hand lamps hangs under the lantern-shed beam; Shen Deng tops up oil and adjusts each wick.
Two market-opening bells hang under the lantern-shed eaves; Shen Deng reaches up and lets them jingle.

actions: Shen Deng hangs the golden carp lantern on a rod and tests the belly oil lamp.
Through a gap in the reed wall Shen Deng watches the river-pier stone bridge darken.

actions.action: The golden carp lantern's gold-leaf scales leap vivid under the tung-oil lamps.

actions: Shen Deng sits against a bamboo rack and listens to river wind through the reeds.
Shen Deng draws the lantern-making manual from a wood box and spreads it on his knees.
With charcoal Shen Deng marks tonight's golden-carp scale layers on the manual.
Shen Deng closes the lantern-making manual and tucks it back into the wood box.

actions.action: A tung-oil lamp flickers; gold-leaf glare from the golden carp lantern sweeps Shen Deng's cheek.

scenes.setting: Drying ground greets the apprentice (three bamboo-frame tags)
actions: At the morning riverside drying ground, Shen Deng greets young Tuantuan pushing the lantern cart.

actions.action: Tuantuan stops the vermilion cart at the drying-ground edge and wedges the wheels with wood.
Shen Deng points to the three bamboo-frame tags on the post and teaches Tuantuan to read color dots and lantern types.
Tuantuan squats by the tamped earth and curiously touches the dried gauze faces.
Shen Deng explains festival entrance-exit cues to Tuantuan.
Tuantuan looks back at the intact lantern cart, eyes full of longing.

actions: Behind a sugar-figure stall at the lantern-fair night market, Yuanyuan with the ink-green scarf turns to look.
Yuanyuan strides across the stone road, swaggering.
Yuanyuan bargains with a stallkeeper; the paper-kite hair clip at the temple sways lightly.
Yuanyuan carries a bamboo basket through the sea of lantern crowds.
On the riverside drying ground Tuantuan and Yuanyuan stand side by side—one ochre-red scarf, one ink-green.
Tuantuan hands a tag to Yuanyuan; they lock eyes briefly.
Yuanyuan tidies Tuantuan's ochre-red scarf, then turns away.
They part by the stone bridge and walk opposite ways.
Months later at night, Shen Deng keeps watch alone in the lantern shed; the golden carp lantern hangs on its rod.

actions.action: Shen Deng opens the lantern-making manual; the cover is soaked through with candle oil, diagrams bled into yellow blotches.

actions: Shen Deng wipes soot from the golden carp lantern with a cloth.
Through a gap in the reed wall Shen Deng watches the pitch-black stone bridge.

actions.action: The golden carp lantern sways slowly under the tung-oil lamps.

actions: Before the Lantern Festival Shen Deng pastes gauze and foil day after day.
Another rainy night Shen Deng checks whether bamboo frames have taken damp.
At high-summer noon Shen Deng wipes sun-hot brass lamp pans.
Autumn wind crosses the river pier; Shen Deng keeps vigil alone till dawn.
Another New Year's Eve festival, Shen Deng keeps the golden carp lit till dawn.

scenes.setting: Drying-ground rounds (recall tags · strange green-hide cart)
actions: At dawn Shen Deng patrols the riverside drying ground; the lantern cart sits under the poplars.

actions.action: Shen Deng crouches to check the cart shaft tenons.
Shen Deng walks to the post; those earlier three bamboo-frame tags still hang in place.
A strange green-hide cart rolls across the drying ground—denser spokes, not the vermilion lantern cart.
Shen Deng stands at the drying-ground edge noting last night's wind effect on lantern frames.
Shen Deng folds the dried gauze faces and weights them on a stone pier.

scenes.setting: Candle-fire catastrophe (carp burned through · cart burns)
actions: Wind rises at midnight; a tung-oil lamp in the shed tips; the golden carp lantern shakes hard.
Flames lick the gold leaf; pale smoke-light fills the shed.

actions.action: With a sharp crack the golden carp lantern's belly is burned through by candle flame; bamboo frame smoked black and cracked.
On the drying ground the lantern cart is ignited by flying sparks.
The lantern cart overturns and burns; shafts charred black, lanterns reduced to ash wreckage.
Shen Deng rushes into the lantern shed and clutches the burned-through golden carp lantern hard.
Next day Shen Deng stands in the lantern shed staring at the candle-burned-through golden carp lantern.
Shen Deng strokes the smoked-black bamboo frame with a fingertip, expression darkened.
On a shed post Shen Deng charcoal-notes the date the lantern cart burned.
An old photo of the lantern cart is still nailed to the shed wall; Shen Deng gazes a long time.
Shen Deng takes down one of the five tung-oil hand lamps from the beam and sits alone by its faint light.
The damaged golden carp lantern still hangs on its rod; the scales have a gap.

scenes.setting: Rebacking repair (paper-paste small carp lantern false friend)
actions: Weeks later Shen Deng brings new gauze and gold leaf and begins rebacking the golden carp lantern.

actions.action: From a wood box Shen Deng takes a paper-paste small carp lantern—posed like the golden carp but without gold leaf.

actions: Shen Deng carefully reinforces the bamboo frame and fits new gauze and gold leaf.

actions.action: The golden carp lantern's belly is lightable again; scales vivid.

actions: The repaired golden carp lantern leaps under the tung-oil lamps; Shen Deng breathes out.

scenes.setting: False friends: replica cart and Festival steward

actions.action: A blue-gray replica cart rolls onto the drying ground—nothing like the long overturned-and-burned lantern cart.
Festival steward jumps down from the cart and talks beside Shen Deng; the two builds are close.
The steward points at the replica cart and explains the temporary bamboo-strip haul.
The replica cart rumble-rolls away; Shen Deng alone watches it leave the drying ground.
Into the lantern-fair night market comes a sugar-figure girl with a light-brown scarf; at a glance she somewhat resembles young Tuantuan.
The girl tries handing over sugar figures, but Shen Deng shakes his head—she is not Tuantuan after all.

scenes.setting: Lamp tower eye wound (copper bells long-range)

actions.action: Years later at dusk, Shen Deng with right eye bandaged leans on a bamboo cane under the abandoned lamp tower.

actions: Shen Deng looks up at the broken looking-posts, gaze distant.

actions.action: Those two market-opening bells at the lamp-tower eaves corner ring lightly in the wind; Shen Deng stops to listen.

actions: Shen Deng presses his palm to the cold brick platform, as if saying goodbye.

actions.action: By day, adult Tuantuan returns along the river pier and hurries toward the abandoned lamp tower.

actions: Under the brick tower Tuantuan reunites with cane-leaning Shen Deng; they embrace.

actions.action: Beside the lantern-shed straw mat, Tuantuan holds Shen Deng's withered hand.
Shen Deng's breath fades; at last he closes his eyes and dies.
Behind the lantern-shed door Shen Deng's vermilion short jacket still hangs; Tuantuan reaches to stroke it lightly.
By the lantern-shed lintel, adult Tuantuan stands before the lantern-maker's brass plaque.
Tuantuan's fingertip traces Shen Deng's name engraved on the plaque.
Adult Yuanyuan arrives from the night market and locks eyes with Tuantuan under the lamp tower.

actions: Tuantuan and Yuanyuan stand side by side at the tower lip—one calm-eyed, one deep-faced.
They look at each other in silence, studying faces alike yet different.

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—the youth who wedged the cart wheels on the drying ground appears again.

anchor.phrase: the youth who wedged the cart wheels on the drying ground

actions.action: The opening moment returns—on the lantern-shed rod, a gold-leaf carp lantern is lit for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the gold-leaf carp lantern first lit at the opening

actions.action: Flash to that year's night market—the figure with ink-green scarf and paper-kite hair clip flickers past.

anchor.phrase: the figure with ink-green scarf at that year's night market

actions.action: Again that row of five old tung-oil hand lamps under the lantern-shed beam appears.

anchor.phrase: that row of five old hand lamps under the lantern-shed beam

actions.action: Back to the riverside tamped-earth yard of first meeting; festival flags sway in the wind as before.

anchor.phrase: the riverside tamped-earth yard of first meeting

actions.action: Tuantuan reopens that candle-oil-stained lantern-making manual and walks into the lantern shed.
By the drying-ground post, those earlier three bamboo-frame tags still hang in place.
Tuantuan takes the golden carp lantern; the belly lights warm yellow again.
